positive_terms: Disclosure of types of employees who are not covered by social protection, through public programs or through benefits offered, against loss of income due to unemployment starting from when own worker is working for undertaking
未获失业收入保障的员工类型
披露未通过公共计划或主体福利获得失业收入损失保障的员工类型。须说明适用主体、期间与报告边界；泛泛表述不能替代。
